item.mcai.architect_wand.tooltip2: /mcai build <prompt> — let the AI build here
mcai.selection.none: No complete selection. Use the wand (/mcai wand) or /mcai pos1 + /mcai pos2.
mcai.wand.summary: Selection %s → %s (%s × %s × %s). Describe your build with /mcai build <prompt>
mcai.wand.help: Left-click a block for corner 1, right-click a block for corner 2, then /mcai build <prompt>
mcai.wand.given: Here is your Architect's Wand. Left-click: corner 1, right-click: corner 2.
mcai.status.connected: Engine connected · %s world task(s) queued · %s job bar(s)
mcai.status.disconnected: Engine not connected — start it with `mcai serve` (looking for ~/.mcai/engine.json)
mcai.build.queued: Build request sent (job %s). Watch the boss bar for progress.
mcai.hud.off: mcAI job panel hidden (press H to show)
mcai.ui.title: mcAI — AI Architect
mcai.ui.subtitle: AI Architect
mcai.ui.placeholder: Describe your build… e.g. “a cosy timber-frame bakery with a flower garden and a little well”
mcai.ui.status.no_mod_server: This server does not have mcAI installed — AI builds are not available here.
mcai.ui.status.no_permission: You are not allowed to start AI builds on this server (ask an operator).
mcai.ui.status.running: A build is running — cancel it to start a new one.
mcai.ui.status.cooldown: Please wait %s s before the next request.
mcai.ui.status.ready_selection: Ready — the AI builds inside your selection.
mcai.ui.status.ready_size: Ready — the AI builds where you are looking.
mcai.build.no_permission: You are not allowed to start AI builds (needs permission level %s).
mcai.build.empty: Describe what should be built first.
mcai.build.offline: The mcAI engine is not connected.
mcai.build.busy: You already have a build running.
mcai.build.cooldown: Please wait %s s before the next build request.
mcai.build.rejected: The engine did not start the build: %s
mcai.chat.cancel.hover: Stop the running build (placed blocks stay; use Undo)
mcai.engine.not_setup: The mcAI engine is not set up. In the mcAI folder run: ./mcai setup — or set engine.command in config/mcai.json.
mcai.engine.bad_path: %s points to %s, but %s does not exist. Run ./mcai setup in the mcAI folder again.
mcai.engine.no_node: Node.js was not found. Install Node.js 22.18 or newer from https://nodejs.org and restart Minecraft.
mcai.engine.node_broken: %s could not be run. Reinstall Node.js 22.18+ from https://nodejs.org.
mcai.engine.node_old: Node.js %s is too old — the engine needs 22.18 or newer (https://nodejs.org).
mcai.engine.no_claude: Claude Code (claude) was not found — AI builds will fail. Install it: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
mcai.engine.exited: The engine stopped unexpectedly (exit code %s) — see %s
mcai.engine.offline_dedicated: The engine is not running on the server. The server owner can start it with: mcai serve
mcai.engine.offline: The engine is not running. Start it with: mcai serve — or set engine.autoStart to true in config/mcai.json
mcai.selection.new: New selection started (the previous one was used for a build).
mcai.selection.far: Corner %s was %s blocks away and was reset — set it again.
mcai.pause.building: mcAI keeps building while the game is paused
